scripts.build: bun --filter play14-api build && bun --filter play14-web build
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/api lint && bun run --cwd packages/web lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --cwd packages/api lint:fix && bun run --cwd packages/web lint:fix
scripts.check: bun run --cwd packages/api check && bun run --cwd packages/web check
scripts.format: bun run --cwd packages/api format && bun run --cwd packages/web format
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/api typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/api test && bun run --cwd packages/web test
scripts.test:all: bun run --cwd packages/api test && bun run --cwd packages/api test:integration && bun run --cwd packages/web test
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/.next packages/*/build packages/*/dist
